rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: You can score up to 12 points per match. Picks lock automatically when the match kicks off.
rules.whatScore: The score, e.g. 2–1. What counts is the result: home win, draw or away win.
rules.whatGoals: Total goals come from your score. You only choose whether they count as a range or an exact number.
rules.whatCards: Total yellow cards for both teams: a range or an exact number.
rules.whatCorners: Total corners for both teams: a range or an exact number.
rules.example: You pick 2–1, goals as exact (3), cards in range 4-5, corners exactly 9. The match ends 3–0 with 4 cards and 9 corners. You get 3 (result) + 3 (goals) + 1 (cards) + 3 (corners) = 10 pts.
rules.otherPicks: Other players' picks become visible once a match kicks off.
rules.otherPostponed: Postponed and cancelled matches aren't scored.
rules.otherResults: Results are fetched every day at 23:45. Cards and corners are added after the match, so points can appear a little later.
rules.otherTies: On equal points, the player with more exact hits ranks higher.

admin.title: Admin
admin.syncHint: Fetches fixtures, the table, form and H2H (about 13 requests, 1–2 minutes because of the per-minute limit). Re-syncing only refreshes kickoff times and the table.
admin.resultsHint: Fetches results for finished matches and scores picks (cards and corners too, when the source provides them). Also runs automatically at 23:45.
